children.value: > Fact From Story Kenneth Walker III (Seahawks) took four carries against the Rams before leaving with an oblique injury.
> > Fact From Story He was seen walking on the sidelines shortly afterward but ruled doubtful to return.
> > > Fact From Story Following the game, Seahawks head coach Pete Carroll told reporters Walker suffered an "oblique strain that was legit" and could miss time.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge An oblique strain is a type of oblique injury.
> > Commonsense Knowledge Being ruled doubtful to return means that a player will probably not play for the rest of the game.
> Commonsense Knowledge An oblique injury can prevent a running back from continuing to play in a football game.
